name: carnice-v2-27b-nvfp4-text-mtp-pro6000ws-performance-256k-mtp3
notes: Performance-session RTX PRO 6000 WS profile for Carnice/Qwen3.6 27B NVFP4 with MTP n=3. Based on observed PRO 6000 WS startup capacity and c=15 mixed-context testing, uses max_num_seqs=8 as the default throughput-oriented server cap while client/proxy admission control governs active context budgets. Keep max_model_len=262144 for max-context requests, and enforce context parallelism outside vLLM. Uses fp8 KV, prefix caching for repeated agent/tool-call prefixes, max_num_batched_tokens=16384 for better batched prefill without pushing to B200-scale settings, and max_new_tokens=32768 for long agentic responses.
